questions.question: What is CI/CD and why is it important?
questions.answer: CI/CD stands for Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment. CI means automatically building and testing code on every commit. CD means automatically deploying to production. It is important because it catches bugs early, reduces manual work, enables faster releases, and improves code quality.
